description: Source code implementing an in-memory trust store for certificates using Starboard platform APIs, including certificate loading, hashing, and trust management.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard
classes.description: Implements an in-memory trust store for certificates, loading from disk and managing trust relationships.

methods.name: TryLoadCert
methods.description: Attempts to load a certificate by name from disk, returning a parsed certificate if successful.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard
methods.description: Constructor initializing the trust store with certificates found on disk.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate, loading from disk if not found in memory.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Determines the trust level of a given certificate, loading from disk if necessary.
